# Kiosk Satellite Contributor Agreement

Version 1.1

Read this agreement before accepting it through your PR. It explains the exclusive worldwide usage rights you grant while retaining copyright in your contribution.

## 1. Parties and contribution

This agreement is between you as the contributor and Xavier Larrea, an individual based in Ecuador and the author of Kiosk Satellite. If another person or organization owns the relevant rights, you must identify that rights holder and have authority to act for them.

Your Contribution is the original translation material you submit to the [official localization repository](https://github.com/jxlarrea/kiosk-satellite-localization), identified by the PR number, exact head commit and contribution snapshot shown in the acceptance record. It includes only the work you own or are authorized to contribute. It excludes preexisting project material, unrelated work and other people's contributions unless their authority is documented.

This agreement covers that existing Contribution only. Later PRs and changes after acceptance require a fresh acceptance record. It does not license unspecified future work or restrict your ability to create unrelated work.

## 2. Electronic acceptance

Read the agreement linked in your PR before checking the acceptance box yourself while signed into your own GitHub account. The declaration must identify this agreement's version, its fixed repository revision and the exact PR head commit. Checking that declaration expresses your acceptance and your intent to sign electronically.

Acceptance records include the PR description with its disclosures, declaration, agreement text and digest, GitHub account ID and username, authenticated acceptance event, timestamp and identified Contribution. A maintainer or bot checking a box does not count as your acceptance. A checked box for an earlier revision or earlier PR disclosures does not cover later changes. Each relevant rights holder must be covered by their own acceptance or documented authority.

Xavier Larrea accepts the covered Contribution by deliberately merging it into the official repository after its acceptance record is complete. The exclusive license below takes effect on that acceptance. If the PR is rejected or withdrawn before acceptance, the exclusive license does not take effect. The limited review permissions in the [repository license](../LICENSE) remain separate.

An automated check records acceptance. It does not override mandatory legal formalities or prove that you own the rights. A Contribution cannot be accepted through this process when its required rights or formalities remain unresolved.

## 3. Exclusive worldwide license

On acceptance by Xavier Larrea, you grant him an exclusive, worldwide license to exercise your copyright and related rights in the identified Contribution for the uses below. The license lasts for the full remaining duration of those rights, including extensions to the extent permitted by law. It is royalty-free except for mandatory legal entitlements.

The licensed uses include reproduction, storage, correction, editing, adaptation, translation, combination with other material, distribution, publication, public display, communication and making available to the public. They include source catalogs, generated resources, downloadable applications, local and networked interfaces, websites, documentation and printed material using means known at acceptance.

To the extent permitted by law, Xavier Larrea may exercise the licensed rights commercially or noncommercially, grant sublicenses under terms he chooses and transfer the license to others. You consent to those sublicenses, license transfers and modifications within the stated uses where your consent is required and can validly be given. Mandatory limits and any additional legally required consent remain effective. Transferring this license does not transfer your copyright ownership.

The grant is exclusive against others and yourself for the licensed uses, subject to the contribution permissions in the repository license, the service-provider exception in section 5 and mandatory law. You must not grant conflicting rights or independently exploit the Contribution within those exclusive uses. You may continue participating in the official contribution process. The license is not revocable at will, subject to statutory termination rights and other mandatory remedies.

The grant is voluntary and gratuitous except for any entitlement that applicable law does not allow you to waive. No fee, royalty or revenue share is promised. Xavier Larrea undertakes the credit obligations in section 6. You agree to provide reasonable further documentation needed to evidence the agreed license at his expense. A nonexclusive permission alone does not meet the project's acceptance requirements.

## 4. Ownership and retained rights

You retain copyright ownership and authorship in your original Contribution. This agreement grants usage rights and does not assign copyright to Xavier Larrea. Your retained ownership remains subject to the exclusive license you grant.

The agreement does not create copyright in unprotectable phrases or other material lacking copyright protection. It does not remove moral rights, statutory termination rights, mandatory remuneration or other protections that cannot lawfully be waived. Xavier Larrea retains his existing rights in Kiosk Satellite. This agreement does not grant you ownership of the application.

## 5. Authorship and assurances

You confirm that you are an adult with legal capacity to enter this agreement and hold the rights granted or have documented authority from their holder. Disclose employer, client, coauthor and other interests before acceptance. Do not accept for someone else's work without authority.

You confirm that your Contribution is original except for disclosed material approved by Xavier Larrea. Disclose prior publication, existing licenses, third-party material and machine translation assistance relevant to your ability to grant these rights. Do not submit material subject to incompatible rights or undisclosed restrictions. Notify Xavier Larrea through the repository if you discover a rights problem.

Within the limits in section 4, you consent to ordinary translation corrections, shortening, reformatting, adaptation and combination with other project material. No consent permits an act that applicable law makes impermissible despite your consent.

### AI and translation-service assistance

You may use AI or machine translation to help prepare the Contribution if you review every submitted message yourself and disclose the provider, product, account type, applicable terms and how you used it in the PR. You remain responsible for the wording and for having the rights you grant. A tool is not a human coauthor and must not be listed in a `Co-Authored-By` commit trailer. Disclose any actual human coauthor separately.

The exclusive grant in section 3 is subject to nonexclusive permissions given to a disclosed service provider to process, transmit and store content, operate and secure the service, prevent abuse and comply with legal obligations. This exception covers only those service functions and associated retention under the disclosed terms. It does not allow you to separately publish, sell or license the Contribution outside the official contribution process. It does not authorize a provider to distribute the translation catalog as a separate product.

This agreement does not promise that generated wording is unique or create copyright in output that applicable law does not protect. Independently produced similar wording is not by itself a violation of this agreement. Human review alone does not establish that every generated phrase is copyrightable. The exclusive grant covers only rights you actually hold or are authorized to license, subject to section 4 and the disclosed exceptions above.

## 6. Credit and project decisions

Xavier Larrea will credit accepted Contributions in the repository's credits using your chosen public name or pseudonym and contributed language. When your translation first ships, its credit will be included in the app's localization credits. Historical credit remains when wording changes.

You may request correction of your public name or removal of public attribution from current records and future releases. An omission or error will be corrected within a reasonable period after notice. Already distributed releases and third-party copies may retain their earlier credits. Credit obligations do not restrict mandatory legal remedies.

Contributing does not give you ownership of Kiosk Satellite, employment, a partnership, control over releases or a veto over edits. Xavier Larrea decides whether and when to release, revise, replace or remove accepted translations. You have no ongoing maintenance obligation. Acceptance does not guarantee a particular release date.

## 7. Records and privacy

The [contributor privacy notice](CONTRIBUTOR-PRIVACY.md) explains the acceptance records and credit information. Do not post legal identity documents or private contact information in PRs. Any additional identity or authority verification must use an appropriate private route.

You may retain the agreement and acceptance record for your own records. Deleting a public checkbox or comment after acceptance does not itself undo a valid license. This does not limit any statutory right to terminate or challenge it.

pr_description:
Adds Simplified Chinese (zh-CN, 简体中文) for all 3,772 messages in the current pinned Kiosk Satellite catalog across 194 ARB files. The contributor has completed human review of the full translation and checked the translated remote administration interface locally, with no issues reported.

Related coordination issue: #9.

## Translation and review

- Language tag: `zh-CN`; ARB locale: `zh_CN`.
- English source revision: `f91f5183e2a66f539b9132f5ed0de2482ed9efd5`.
- Localization repository base: `8d341c8270dbe91283a24772b07b76ff6479789c`.
- Public credit: **panda-star357**, https://github.com/panda-star357.
- The contributor confirmed on October 4, 2026 that every translation had been manually reviewed. All 3,772 review records match the final wording. No exempt or pending messages remain.
- The final eight wording corrections cover the device-name placeholder, volume button labels, font weight titles and the empty Immich exclude-people selection. All were supplied or explicitly confirmed by the contributor.
- The contributor checked the translated remote administration preview and reported no issues. The preview uses the application's official localization preview generator and remote UI source, connected to the K10's actual settings.

Terminology consistently uses 仪表盘 for Dashboard, 屏保 for Screensaver, 正在播放 for Now Playing, 页面保持模式 for Hold Mode and 设备群管理 for Fleet Management. Photo filling describes the photo's aspect ratio relative to the screen. Configuration export preserves the meaning of page local storage. Immich's empty exclude-people selection reads 未选择人物. Product names, message IDs, placeholders, URLs, commands and configuration values are preserved. Native Voice Satellite and legacy integration wording remain distinct.

## AI assistance and rights disclosure

- OpenAI Codex, accessed through a ChatGPT Business account, assisted with drafting, refinement, source research and technical validation. Applicable terms: https://openai.com/policies/services-agreement/ (especially section 4, Customer Content).
- The contributor confirmed optional training and content sharing were disabled before translation work. No earlier use with those settings enabled is reported for this task. The settings were confirmed by the contributor, not independently audited by the assistant.
- Other human wording contributors: none declared. The contributor supplied their own corrections through the review process.
- Other projects' style guides informed general writing principles only. Their translations were not copied into this contribution.

## Validation

- `python3 tools/catalog.py validate --repo .`: passed, `zh-CN: 3772/3772 translated`.
- New-language completeness checks against the full base and contribution commit SHAs: passed, `0 missing; 0 source changes need review`.
- `git diff --check`: passed.
- Additional checks passed for message coverage, placeholder sets, product names, URLs, final review records and agreement between packaged files and submitted ARBs.
- The official local preview generator included all 3,772 Simplified Chinese messages, matching the final ARBs exactly.
- This PR changes translation ARB files only. Language registration, credit metadata and reviewed provenance are left to the maintainer.

## Font compatibility and rendering

- Remote administration: the contributor completed local rendering review and reported no issues. The assistant also checked Login, Device, Voice Satellite, Screensaver, Immich Media Screensaver and Widgets; the inspected Chinese text was readable, with no obvious clipping or missing glyphs.
- Preview application source revision: `417fed515f9d4a1ac6399cab08a163f183e06e62`. Its English catalog matches this translation's source catalog.
- Connected device: K10, Lenovo TB-X6C6NBF, Android 12, Kiosk Satellite 2026.10.6. Preview viewed in the Codex in-app browser on macOS.
- This was a locally served translated remote UI using the author's `generate --preview-repo --preview-locale zh-CN` workflow. Device configuration writes were confined to local preview values.
- Android device interface: rendering in a translated APK has not yet been tested. The available test setup covered the computer's remote UI. Device font and layout review still require a build containing Simplified Chinese.
- No font changes are proposed. Translated application screenshots are not attached to this PR.

The PR remains a draft for the remaining Android rendering review and the contributor's personal acceptance of the agreement for this final revision. Human language review and the contributor's remote UI review are complete.

## Before review

- [x] A fluent human has reviewed every translation for meaning, grammar and consistency.
- [x] Message IDs, placeholders and technical values are preserved and checked.
- [x] The contributor has checked the translated remote administration preview.
- [ ] Rendering in the Android device interface has been checked in a build containing this translation.

## Agreement acceptance

The contributor will personally read and accept the generated declaration using their own GitHub account for the final PR revision. No assistant has accepted on their behalf.
